source_note: This page integrates IDSA 2016, Ullmann et al. 2018 (executive summary of the 2017 ESCMID-ECMM-ERS guideline), and Denning et al. 2016 CPA guidance. Sources are kept distinct at row level. IDSA and ESCMID/ECMM/ERS recommendation grades use different systems; grades are not numerically interchangeable.

guideline_comparison.title: Cross-guideline comparison — invasive pulmonary aspergillosis
rows: Voriconazole primary; L-AmB and isavuconazole primary alternatives; routine echinocandin monotherapy not recommended.
Isavuconazole and voriconazole are A-rated first-line options; L-AmB 3 mg/kg has B-level support; combinations are not routinely preferred.
Voriconazole/isavuconazole are central first-line agents; lipid AmB remains an alternative.
Do not merge grades across systems; exact positioning of L-AmB, echinocandins and combinations differs.

normalization_note: Dose notation: LD=loading dose; q24h=daily; BID=twice daily; TID=three times daily; QID=four times daily; PO=oral; IV=intravenous. Formulation-specific azole doses must not be interchanged.
